summary.zh-tw: 古寧頭戰役的傷亡數字是雙方爭議最大的議題之一。國軍、解放軍與第三方學者的統計差異顯著。
summary.en: Casualty figures from the Battle of Guningtou remain among the most disputed aspects. Figures from ROC, PLA, and third-party scholars differ significantly.

roc.zh-tw: 國軍統計：解放軍陣亡約3,000餘人、被俘約7,000人。國軍傷亡約2,000餘人。
roc.en: ROC figures: ~3,000 PLA killed, ~7,000 captured. ROC casualties: ~2,000.

pla.zh-tw: 解放軍承認第一梯隊9,086人中多數未能返回。具體傷亡數字長期未公開。
pla.en: PLA acknowledges the majority of the 9,086-strong first echelon did not return. Specific casualty figures remained classified for decades.

disputes.zh-tw: 國軍：3,000+。部分學者估計更高
國軍：依日內瓦公約對待俘虜。部分口述史稱俘虜待遇惡劣
disputes.en: ROC: treated per Geneva Convention. Some oral accounts report harsh treatment.
